frameworks.title: Root system: 3 letters carry meaning
frameworks.body: Most words come from 3-letter roots. K-T-B → kitab (book), katib (writer), maktab (office), maktaba (library). Learn roots and vocabulary explodes.

frameworks.title: Reads right to left
frameworks.body: Letters change shape based on position (start/middle/end of word). Same letter, four forms. Practice writing — it cements recognition.

frameworks.title: No 'is' in present tense
frameworks.body: 'The house big' = the house IS big. The verb 'to be' simply isn't used in the present. Cleaner than English.

frameworks.title: Diglossia: written ≠ spoken
frameworks.body: Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) is for news and books. Each region has its own dialect for daily life. Start with MSA.
